title: Zipping the Thought: When and How Compressed Reasoning Data Works in LLM Post-Training
authors_zh: Kohsei Matsutani, Gouki Minegishi, Takeshi Kojima, Yusuke Iwasawa, Yutaka Matsuo
paper_type_zh: 压缩推理数据的受控研究
best_for_zh: 适合选择 CoT 粒度及 SFT、RLVR 数据预算的研究者。
one_line: Zipping the Thought varies CoT compression in controlled synthetic data to show how data diversity, repetition, and RLVR affect step decomposition and length generalization.
Zipping the Thought 在受控合成数据中改变 CoT 压缩粒度，分析数据多样性、重复训练与 RLVR 如何影响步骤拆解和长度泛化。
why: It separates trace granularity from data volume and optimization, giving concrete rules for designing compressed reasoning supervision.
inclusion_reason: Provides controlled evidence about when compressed reasoning traces help SFT and when RLVR can recover omitted atomic steps.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Compressed CoT reduces training and inference tokens, but shorter traces can mean two different things: several operations are composed into one explicit step, or intermediate operations are omitted entirely. Existing post-training studies rarely isolate how those choices interact with data scale, repetition, generalization length, and later RLVR.

Zipping the Thought builds a fully controlled modulo-arithmetic task and renders each dependency chain as Explicit, Composed, or Implicit CoT at chosen granularities. It then varies only trace type, data budget, order, or SFT/RLVR stage to identify when compressed reasoning is learned, memorized, or decomposed again.

L4 facts: official source arXiv:2605.28008, 2026; preprint marked under review with no confirmed acceptance; decision boundary is a controlled reasoning trace whose operations, compression, split, and answer are generator-known; Track-01 object is a synthetic question, selected CoT target, and exact answer; collected as an existing promoted Card.

压缩 CoT 可以减少训练和推理 token，但更短的轨迹可能代表两件不同的事：把多个运算合并成一个显式步骤，或完全省略中间运算。已有后训练研究很少隔离这些选择与数据规模、重复训练、长度泛化和后续 RLVR 的关系。

Zipping the Thought 构建完全受控的模运算任务，并把每条依赖链按指定粒度渲染为 Explicit、Composed 或 Implicit CoT。随后只改变轨迹类型、数据预算、顺序或 SFT/RLVR 阶段，以识别压缩推理何时被学会、被记忆，或在 RL 中重新拆开。

L4 事实：官方来源为 arXiv:2605.28008，年份为 2026；预印本标注 under review，未确认接收；判定边界是生成器已知运算、压缩、划分与答案的受控推理轨迹；Track 01 对象是合成问题、指定 CoT target 与精确答案组成的记录；该条目是已有并已提升的 Card。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The paper makes CoT compression an explicit data variable. Explicit CoT emits every atomic operation; Composed CoT groups several operations into one step but still shows their calculation; Implicit CoT skips intermediate operations and values. A deterministic task generator keeps the underlying dependency chain and answer fixed, so differences can be attributed to supervision granularity rather than question difficulty or teacher quality.

Google Scholar citations: 0（checked 2026-07-27；https://scholar.google.com/scholar_lookup?title=Zipping+the+Thought%3A+When+and+How+Compressed+Reasoning+Data+Works+in+LLM+Post-Training&author=Kohsei+Matsutani&hl=en）

Open dataset: no fixed released corpus was confirmed. The official repository https://github.com/kohseim/cot_compression provides data-generation, SFT, RLVR, and evaluation code capable of producing up to 768K records per run. Each record contains a synthetic modulo-23 dependency-chain question, operation count, distractor settings, CoT type and granularity, rendered trace, and final integer answer. Exact train/evaluation duplicates are removed; short chains train the model and longer chains test out-of-distribution generalization. File format and license were not confirmed. Intended use: controlled CoT-granularity, repetition, SFT, and RLVR experiments rather than natural-domain training.

论文把 CoT 压缩设为显式数据变量。Explicit CoT 输出每个原子运算；Composed CoT 把多个运算合成一步，但仍展示对应计算；Implicit CoT 省略中间运算和值。确定性任务生成器保持底层依赖链和答案一致，因此差异可以归因于监督粒度，而不是题目难度或教师质量。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Generate a dependency task. Input: operation count, random arithmetic operators, entity names, and distractor parameters. Operation: build a sequential chain modulo 23 and compute every intermediate state deterministically. Output: a question graph and exact final integer. Check: remove exact train/evaluation duplicates and verify the answer by execution.
  2. Render trace granularity. Input: the same solved chain and a CoT type. Operation: emit every operation for Explicit CoT, combine groups of g operations for Composed CoT, or omit their intermediate operations for Implicit CoT. Output: alternative targets with identical task semantics. Check: all variants must end at the same verified answer.
  3. Construct controlled splits. Input: rendered examples. Operation: balance training across operation counts 8, 16, and 24; create data budgets from 6K to 768K, and reserve longer chains from 32 through 104 operations for OOD evaluation. Output: matched SFT and length-generalization sets. Check: vary one of scale, granularity, ordering, or diversity at a time.
  4. Run SFT and repetition tests. Input: Qwen2.5 or Llama targets and one trace set. Operation: train with LLaMA-Factory; compare one epoch on 384K diverse records, 64 epochs on the same 6K records, and one epoch on 6K. Output: checkpoints under matched exposure or data diversity. Check: track pass@1 by unseen chain length to separate learning from memorization.
  5. Run RLVR after compressed SFT. Input: checkpoints SFT-trained on 24K Explicit, Composed-g=2, or Implicit-g=2 records. Operation: apply GRPO with eight rollouts and exact final-answer reward on unseen odd/even short operation counts. Output: policies that may expand compressed operations into smaller steps. Check: compare before/after pass@1, response length, and emitted operation granularity on much longer chains.

Reproducibility: the official repository provides generators and training/evaluation scripts rather than a fixed dataset. Pin random seeds, modulo/task grammar, operation splits, distractors, CoT templates, model checkpoints, token budgets, LLaMA-Factory/verl versions, and GRPO settings; repository license remains unconfirmed.

1. 生成依赖任务。 输入：运算数量、随机算术运算符、实体名称与干扰项参数。操作：构建模 23 的顺序依赖链，并确定性计算每个中间状态。输出：问题图与精确最终整数。检查：删除训练评测精确重复，并通过执行验证答案。
  2. 渲染轨迹粒度。 输入：同一条已求解依赖链和一种 CoT 类型。操作：Explicit CoT 输出每个运算，Composed CoT 把每 g 个运算合成一组，Implicit CoT 省略这些运算的中间过程。输出：任务语义相同的不同 target。检查：所有版本必须得到同一个已验证答案。
  3. 构建受控划分。 输入：渲染后的样本。操作：在运算数为 8、16、24 的训练题间保持平衡，构建从 6K 到 768K 的数据预算，并把 32 至 104 个运算的更长链留作分布外评测。输出：匹配的 SFT 与长度泛化数据。检查：每次只改变规模、粒度、顺序或多样性中的一个变量。
  4. 执行 SFT 与重复实验。 输入：Qwen2.5 或 Llama 目标模型和一种轨迹数据。操作：使用 LLaMA-Factory 训练，比较 384K 条不同记录训练 1 个 epoch、同 6K 条记录重复 64 个 epoch，以及 6K 条记录训练 1 个 epoch。输出：样本暴露量或数据多样性匹配的 checkpoint。检查：按未见链长度统计 pass@1，以区分学习与记忆。
  5. 在压缩 SFT 后执行 RLVR。 输入：分别在 24K 条 Explicit、Composed-g=2 或 Implicit-g=2 记录上完成 SFT 的 checkpoint。操作：在未见过的奇数或偶数短运算长度上，用 8 次 rollout 和精确最终答案奖励执行 GRPO。输出：可能把压缩运算重新拆成小步骤的策略。检查：在更长链上比较训练前后 pass@1、回答长度与实际输出运算粒度。

复现信息：官方仓库提供生成器和训练评测脚本，而不是固定数据集。需要固定随机种子、模运算任务语法、运算划分、干扰项、CoT 模板、模型 checkpoint、token 预算、LLaMA-Factory 与 verl 版本及 GRPO 设置；仓库许可仍未确认。

title: Evidence
证据
html: RLVR decomposition claim. Starting from Qwen2.5-3B checkpoints trained on the same 24K-example SFT budget, GRPO with exact answer reward raises long-chain pass@1 from 2.52 to 67.80 after Composed CoT SFT and from 3.23 to 89.34 after Implicit CoT SFT on the reported held-out operation lengths. The matched task, model, budget, and optimizer show that RLVR can recover atomic computation after compressed supervision; the result is specific to this executable arithmetic environment.

RLVR 重新拆步主张。 从使用相同 24K 样本 SFT 预算的 Qwen2.5-3B checkpoint 出发，在论文报告的留出运算长度上，使用精确答案奖励的 GRPO 把 Composed CoT SFT 后的长链 pass@1 从 2.52 提高到 67.80，把 Implicit CoT SFT 后的结果从 3.23 提高到 89.34。任务、模型、预算和优化器保持匹配，说明 RLVR 能在压缩监督后恢复原子计算；该结论仍限于本文可执行算术环境。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Prior work often treats all shortened reasoning as one compression axis. This paper separates composed steps, which retain the operations inside a larger expression, from implicit steps, which omit operations, then independently controls granularity, scale, repetition, order, and optimization stage. The novelty is the taxonomy plus a generator that isolates their causal training effects. Synthetic arithmetic and CoT compression themselves are not new.
以往工作常把所有缩短推理视为同一个压缩轴。本文区分保留大表达式内部运算的 composed step 与省略运算的 implicit step，再独立控制粒度、规模、重复、顺序和优化阶段。新意在于这套分类及能隔离训练因果效应的生成器；合成算术和 CoT 压缩本身并不新。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
• Results come from linear modulo-23 dependency chains; branching search, natural-language knowledge, diagrams, and domain shift may respond differently to compression.
  • Experiments cover selected Transformer families and length extrapolation, so the proposed rules are not universal across architectures or reasoning tasks.
  • The repository releases generators rather than a frozen dataset, and its license was not confirmed; exact replication depends heavily on seeds and templates.

• 结果来自线性模 23 依赖链；分支搜索、自然语言知识、图表和领域迁移对压缩可能有不同反应。
  • 实验只覆盖部分 Transformer 家族和长度外推，因此这些规律不能直接视为适用于所有架构或推理任务。
  • 仓库发布生成器而不是冻结数据集，且许可未确认；精确复现高度依赖随机种子与模板。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
• Use the taxonomy before compressing SFT data: decide whether steps are algebraically composed or actually omitted, because they learn differently.
  • Run matched diversity-versus-repetition tests instead of treating token count or epoch count as data scale.
  • If exact rewards exist, test whether RLVR re-expands useful atomic steps; do not assume the arithmetic result transfers to open-ended natural tasks.

• 压缩 SFT 数据前应先用该分类判断：步骤是代数合并，还是实际被省略，因为两者学习行为不同。
  • 应做多样性与重复次数匹配的实验，不能把 token 数或 epoch 数直接当成数据规模。
  • 如果存在精确奖励，可测试 RLVR 是否重新展开有用原子步骤；不能假设算术结果会直接迁移到开放式自然任务。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Position: distinguish kinds of short CoT before deciding how compressed supervision affects post-training.
  • Method handle: deterministic chain, three CoT types, controlled scale/repetition/order, length-OOD SFT, exact-reward GRPO.
  • Data/artifact handle: official code generates up to 768K records; no fixed dataset or confirmed license is claimed.
  • Evidence anchor: Qwen2.5-3B RLVR moves Composed 2.52 to 67.80 and Implicit 3.23 to 89.34 on held-out long chains.
  • Reuse decision: use as an experimental design template, not direct evidence that natural-domain CoT should always be compressed.

• 一句话定位： 在判断压缩监督如何影响后训练前，先区分不同类型的短 CoT。
  • 方法抓手： 确定性依赖链、三种 CoT、受控规模重复与顺序、长度分布外 SFT、精确奖励 GRPO。
  • 数据与产物抓手： 官方代码可生成最多 768K 条记录；没有固定数据集，也未确认许可。
  • 证据锚点： Qwen2.5-3B 经 RLVR 后，Composed 在留出长链上从 2.52 到 67.80，Implicit 从 3.23 到 89.34。
  • 复用决定： 应把它当作实验设计模板，而不是自然领域 CoT 总应压缩的直接证据。
